criteria.text: Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Arden Pharma plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $179,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $178,180,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $14,400,000 but 10% of the $180,000,000 Purchase Price is $18,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Arden Pharma plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($180,000,000 - $910,000 = $179,090,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
